description: You are a hospitalist reviewing a chest CT for a patient admitted with hypertension and exertional dyspnea. The attending cardiologist has asked you to assess for cardiomegaly using the cardiothoracic ratio (CTR) before the echocardiogram is available. Using Weasis, open the CT series stored at /home/ga/DICOM/studies/chest_ct/, apply the appropriate window and level settings for cardiac assessment, navigate to the axial slice showing the maximum transverse cardiac diameter, place two separate line measurements: one across the widest transverse cardiac diameter and another across the widest inner thoracic cage diameter at the same level. Then export the annotated slice as a PNG image to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/cardiac_analysis.png. Finally, open a text editor and write the following to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/cardiac_report.txt: the cardiac width in mm, the thoracic width in mm, and the calculated cardiothoracic ratio (cardiac/thoracic, as a decimal). A CTR above 0.50 suggests cardiomegaly.
